The [background page](../../background.qmd) presents the original study, its replication in the SCORE replicability study and the five reanalyses of the SCORE robustness study [@AczelEtAl2026InvestigatingAnalyticalRobustness]. The self-taught format takes all six tasks, and you do them in the workspace, which stage 1 installs and which you open in your IDE (Positron, RStudio, VS Code, etc.). The [browser lab](../../lab.qmd), on which R runs inside your browser, holds every task as well, with hints and worked solutions, and it carries the work if your installation fails. Stage 1 takes Task 1, stage 3 Tasks 2 and 3, and stage 4 Tasks 4 to 6. Sending your results to the class chart is optional.

### Your own project

Stage 5 asks a question beyond the claim, one that the data of the case study support, and fixes its preregistration with a date that someone else can check before anything in it runs. The page of [stage 5](stage-5.qmd) lists the projects that the case study supports.
